sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Twitch Winter 2025 case (Rare) (Twitch 2025) is a Event Reward Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A case with some rare goodies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can only be opened outside of a raid
- Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")
